question.text: In the Claisen-Schmidt reaction to prepare \(351 \mathrm{~g}\) of dibenzalacetone using \(87 \mathrm{~g}\) of acetone, the amount of benzaldehyde required is ______ g. (Nearest integer)

solution.text:
Claisen Schmidt reaction
mw of benzaldehyde $=106$ $106 \times 3=318 \mathrm{gm}$. Benzaldehyde is required to give 1.5 mole (or $351 \mathrm{gm}$ ) product
